name: nuPlan
description: The first closed-loop ML-based planning benchmark for autonomous vehicles, featuring a large-scale driving dataset from multiple cities, a closed-loop simulator with reactive agents, and planning-specific evaluation metrics for long-term motion planning.
reputation: nuPlan is a widely used autonomous driving planning benchmark and one of the standard closed-loop evaluation suites in the field.
notes: Addresses limitations of prior open-loop evaluation by providing closed-loop simulation and metrics for long-term planning.
